why_ai: Causal questions from observational data need judgement, but open-source models and AI-native tools commoditise delivery.
why_clarity: No accepted way exists to check whether any channel-contribution answer is right.
why_digital: Spend and conversion data in, models and dashboards out, sold remotely.

why_ai: The same conversion integration is rebuilt at every client, a repeated pipeline job.
why_clarity: A pipeline either delivers complete, reconciled conversion records or visibly does not.
why_digital: Event, consent and platform data piped and joined in cloud systems.

why_ai: Hierarchical pooling across a client portfolio is the method, and it replaces analyst assumptions.
why_clarity: Pooling methods are standard, but whether a prior was right needs later experiments.
why_digital: Fitted model results across clients are pooled entirely in software.

why_ai: Geo and holdout design, execution and analysis are all automatable statistical routines.
why_clarity: Randomised experiments give a correct incremental answer, though they take weeks to read.
why_digital: Experiments run through ad platforms and are analysed on screen.

why_ai: Open-source MMM makes fitting cheap; the protected remainder is honest specification judgement.
why_clarity: Adstock, saturation and priors are analyst choices and outputs are rarely tested against truth.
why_digital: Spend and sales time series modelled and reported entirely in software.

why_ai: Fractional credit along observed paths is tractable modelling, surviving on client familiarity.
why_clarity: Journeys are mostly unobservable and credit assignment is never checked against causal truth.
why_digital: Clickstream and identity data processed and reported online.

why_ai: Combining biased methods is a statistical problem software can formalise, though judgement drives it today.
why_clarity: Triangulation has no method; it is a spreadsheet and a judgement with no ground truth.
why_digital: Vendor outputs and finance data are combined in spreadsheets and models.

why_ai: Reconciling and explaining five disagreeing numbers is automatable analysis and drafting.
why_clarity: Five sources disagree weekly and nobody can say which number is right.
why_digital: Platform, vendor and finance numbers reconciled in spreadsheets on deadline.

why_ai: Explaining uncertain estimates to sceptical channel owners needs a credible statistician in the room.
why_clarity: Estimates are less certain than charts show, and budget outcomes rarely validate them.
why_digital: Models, charts and presentations are produced and delivered on screen.

why_ai: The model is the product and modelling is exactly what AI-native measurement tools automate.
why_clarity: Methods are codified, but causal answers from observational data cannot be checked.
why_digital: Data ingested and models delivered as software and reports.

why_ai: Backtesting models against experiments is mechanical once experiments exist.
why_clarity: A model's prediction is scored against an experiment's measured lift.
why_digital: Model outputs and experiment results compared entirely in software.
